tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa

skabs brgyad kyi stong thun bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /oṃ swati siddhaṃ hūm̐/ bla ma dang ni 'jam dbyangs kyi// zhabs la gus par phyag 'tshal te// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi// bsdus don zin ris cung zad bri// de yang mngon rtogs rgyan las// shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid// de nas thams cad shes pa nyid// rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang*// rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa// skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub// chos kyi sku dang de rnams brgyad// ces gsungs pas/ yul mkhyen gsum/ thabs sbyor bzhi/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang brgyad do/ /de la dang po mkhyen gsum ngos 'dzin pa la'ang*/ mkhyen gsum tsam po dang*/ skabs dang po gsum du gsungs pa'i mkhyen gsum gnyis yin/ dang po la'ang gsum ste/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshon bya sgra don dang*/ mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po la'ang gsum las/ gzhi shes/ gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi thams cad skye ba med par rtogs pa'o// de la yang shes rgyu'i gzhi dang*/ shes byed kyi blo dang*/ blo des gzhi de ji ltar shes tshul gsum yod pa las/ 1)¿shes rgyu'i gzhi ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad yin la/ de'ang bsdu na bden pa bzhir 'dus te/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang*/ kun 'byung gi bden pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i bden pa dang*/ lam gyi bden pa'o// de rnams re re la'ang rnam pa'i chos bzhi bzhi yod pa las/ dang po sdug bsngal bden pa'i bzhi ni/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ mi rtag pa/ stong pa/ bdag med pa'o/ /kun 'byung gi bzhi ni/ rgyu/ kun 'byung ba/ rab tu skye ba/rkyen gyis rnam pa'o/ /'gog pa'i bden pa'i bzhi ni/ 'gog pa/ zhi ba/ gya nom pa/ nges par 'byung ba'o/ /lam gyi bden pa'i bzhi ni/ lam/ rigs pa/ sgrub pa/ nges par 'byin pa'o// de ltar sdug bsngal bden pa nad dang 'dra bar shes bya/ kun 'byung gi bden pa nad kyi rgyu dang 'dra bar spangs bya/

'gog bden nad med pa dang 'dra bar thob bya/ lam bden sman bzang po dang 'dra bar rgyud la bsten bya yin pa la/ mu stegs pa dang thos bsam gyis blo ma bsgyur ba'i so skye tha mal pa rnams kyis de ltar mi shes so// de'ang sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni/ da lta'i rang gi zag bcas kyi phung po 'di nyid skye ba snga ma'i las dang*/ nyon mongs pas 'du byas nas bskyed pa'i 'bras bu yin pas/ sdug bsngal gsum gyis zin pa'i phung po yin zhing*/ mi gtsang ba sna tshogs las grub pa de ltar ma shes nas/ rtag pa/ gtsang ba/ bde ba/ bdag dang bdag gi bar bden par zhen/ bden zhen de nyid nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa yin pas/ de'i gnyen por nyan rang la sogs kyis so so'i sde snod la thos bsam byas nas/ mi rtag par 'du shes par byas shing*/ rtag pa gtsang ba ni kun rdzob tsam du yang med par shes par byas shing*/ sngar gyi bden zhen de 'gog pa yin no// kun 'byung gi bden pa ni/ rgyus bsdus pa'i zag bcas kyi phung po 'di nyid skye ba phyi ma'i las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang zag bcas kyi phung po kun bskyed pa'i rgyu dang*/ rkyen la sogs pa yin pa la/ mu stegs la sogs pa rang des de ltar ma shes nas/ rtag pa/ gtsang ba bde ba bdag dang bdag gi ba'i rgyu'am/ sdug bsngal la sogs kyi rgyu ma yin par bden par zhen/ bden zhen de yang nyon sgrib yin pas de'i gnyen por thos bsam gyi sgo nas nyan rang la sogs kyis rtag pa gtsang ba gcig pu bdag dang bdag gi ba ni kun rdzob tu'ang med/ mi rtag pa dang mi gtsang ba ni phyi ma'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i rgyu dang lus kun gyi rgyu yin par shes pa byas nas spangs bar byed/ 'gog bden yang nad med pa dang 'dra bar thob bya kun rdzob tu yod pa dang gang zag gi bdag la sogs pas stong pa yin pa la/ mu stegs la sogs kyis de nad med pa dang 'dra bar thob byar mi shes pa'am/

shes kyang rtag pa gcig pu bdag dang bdag gi ba gcig thob rgyu yod par bden par zhen/ bden zhen de'ang nyon sgrib yin pas thos bsam gyi sgo nas nyan thos la sogs kyis rtag pa rang dbang can gyi gang zag gi bdag la sogs pa ni kun rdzob tu'ang med par shes par byas nas 'gog bden nad med pa dang 'dra bar thob byar byed/ lam bden yang sman bzang po dang 'dra bar rgyud la bsten bya yin pa la/ mu stegs la sogs kyis de ltar ma shes pa'am shes kyang rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can lam bden gcig rgyud la bsten rgyu yod yod por bden par zhen/ bden zhen de yang nyon sgrib yin pas thos bsam gyi sgo nas nyan thos la sogs rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can la sogs pa gang zag gi bdag ni kun rdzob tu yang med cing*/ mi rtag pa skad cig ma'i phreng ba yin par shes par byas nas rgyud la bsten byar byed/ des na shes rgyu ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bden pa bzhir bsdus nas/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang kun 'byung gi bden pa 'khor ba yin te/ 'gog bden dang lam bden ni mya ngan las 'das pa yin no// 2)¿de shes byed kyi blo ni/ las dang po pa'i thos bsam nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi bar gyi thos bsam sgom gsum gyi blo rnams yin/ 3)¿blo des gzhi de ji ltar shes tshul ni/ nyan thos rnams kyis gzhi 'khor 'das kyi chos sam/ bden pa bzhi yi rnam pa mi rtag pa la sogs pa bcu drug dang bcas pa de byed pa po bdag gam phya dang dbang phyug la sogs kyis stong ste kun rdzob tsam du yang med/ rang gis ngo bor gyur pa'i gang zag gi bdag rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can gtso bo dang shes rig gi skyes bu ni kun rdzob tsam du yang med pa phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang skyes bu'i lus rags par snang ba rnams dang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs pa yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong sna tshogs su snang ba 'di rnams me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam rmi lam gyi yul ltar rdzun pa yin no//

rags pa 'di rnams rtsom par byed pa'i rdul phra rab cha shas med pa gcig don dam par bden/ shes pa yang 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar ram/ sems can chung ngu btsas ma thag nas ma shi yi bar du rgyun ma chad pa'i pri se snang ba 'di rdzun pa yin la/ rgyun de brtsam par byed pa'i shes pa skad cig ma'i phreng ba srang mda'i mtho dman ltar snga ma 'gag pa dang phyi ma skye ba dus mnyam pa'i skad cig cha shas med pa gcig bden par 'dod/ des na gzhi 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad don dam/ bden pa bzhi la rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can gyi bdag ni kun rdzob tu yang med la/ chos kyi bdag phyi gzung ba rdul phra rab cha med dang*/ nang 'dzin pa skad cig cha med yin pa thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi sgo nas shes par byed pa de nyan thos kyi gzhi shes yin/ rang sangs rgyas kyis shes lugs de'i steng du/ phyi gzung ba'i yul rdul phra rags kyang yang dag par na bden par grub pa med/ nang 'dzin pa skad cig cha med ni mtha' gcig tu bden par zhen nas thos bsam bsgom gsum gyis shes par byed pa de rang sangs rgyas kyi gzhi shes yin/ theg chen pas shes lugs de'i steng du nang 'dzin pa skad cig cha med kyang*/ yang dag par na rang bzhin med/ spros pa dang bral bar thos bsam bsgom gsum gyis shes par byed pa de theg chen pa'i gzhi shes yin te/ de rnams kyi sgo nas gzhi shes ngos bzung ba yin no// lam shes/ gnyis pa lam shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/ lam thams cad skye ba med par rtogs pa yin no/ /de la yang rtogs rgyu'i lam dang*/ rtogs byed kyi blo dang*/ blo des lam de ji ltar rtogs tshul gsum gyi sgo nas ngos 'dzin pa las/ 1)¿de la rtogs rgyu'i lam ni/ sngar bshad pa'i nyan rang dang*/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes gsum yin te/ gzhi shes de gsum la brten nas 'khor ba nas mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba'i bar ro//

de yang lam de gsum theg chen gyi gang zag yul gcig gi rgyud la yon tan yar ldan du tshang ba yin te/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' gcig gis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bden pa bzhi gang zag gi bdag rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can gyis stong par rtogs pa'i ngos nas nyan thos kyi gzhi shes dang 'dra la/ de'i steng du phyi gzung ba'i yul rdul phra rags rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i ngos nas rang sangs rgyas kyi gzhi shes dang 'dra zhing*/ de'i steng du nang 'dzin pa'ang rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i ngos nas theg pa chen po rang nyid kyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir ro// rtoḍa tshul de gsum yang gang zag gcig gi rgyud steng du rtsi na/ blo ngo bo gcig la ldog pas phye ba'i tha dad gsum yin gyi rdzas tha dad ma yin no// de shes rgyu'i lam gang zag gcig gi rgyud steng du tshang ba'i gzhi shes gsum po yin la/ 2)¿shes byed kyi blo ni/ byang chub sems dpa' kho rang gi gzhi shes de yin/ 3)¿blo des lam de ji ltar shes tshul ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gcig gi rgyud steng gi gzhi shes gsum po 'khor ba nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sar 'gro ba'i lam yin pas lam zhes kyang zer la/ lam de kho rang gis kho rang yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar shugs la shes pa'i ngos nas lam shes zhes zer/ lam shes 'di nyan rang la med de/ gzhi bden pa gnyis lam 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gang zag gi bdag dang chos kyi bdag phyed dang gnyis kyis stong par rtogs pa'i gzhi shes yod kyang*/ gzhi shes kho rang gi kho rang rang bzhin med par ma rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lam shes ni theg chen kho na na yod do de rnams kyis lam shes ngos bzung ba yin no// rnam mkhyen/ gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rnam pa thams cad skye ba med par rtogs pa yin/ de la yang rtogs rgyu'i rnam pa dang*/ rtogs byed kyi blo dang*/

blo des rnam pa de ji ltar rtogs tshul gsum yod pa las/ 1)¿rtogs rgyu'i rnam pa ni/ gzhi bden pa bzhi la yod pa'i rnam pa mi rtag pa la sogs bcu drug dang*/ theg chen gyi lam shes sam/ mthong lam la yod pa'i rnam pa ye shes skad cig ma bcu drug yin/ de la yang don dam pa'i gnas lugs kyi rnam pa dang*/ kun rdzob kyi gnas lugs kyi rnam pa gnyis/ de yang dang po ni bcu drug po phrag gnyis po yang dag par na spros pa dang bral bar gnas pa de la rnam pa zhes ming btags pa tsam mo// kun rdzob kyi gnas lugs kyi rnam pa ni/ bden pa bzhi'i mi rtag la sogs bcu drug dang*/ mthong lam gyi lam shes skad cig ma bcu drug yin/ de la dang po ni gong du bshad zin la/ yul bden pa bzhi la ltos nas yul can blo chos bzod chos shes rjes bzod rjes shes te bzhi bzhi yod pas bcu drug yin/ de la dang po sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i skad cig ma bzhi yi yul can ye shes ngos 'dzin na/ sdug bsngal bden pa la/ sdug bsngal ba/ mi rtag pa/ stong pa/ bdag med pa bzhi yod pa las/ sdug bsngal ba la yang*/ yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar rtoḍa pa'i blo la sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la chos shes pa'i bzod pa zhes zer/ yang sdug bsngal gyi bden pa 'di nyid rtag pa ma yin zhing*/ yang dag par na mi rtag pa'ang grub pa med par rtogs pa'i ngos nas sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la chos shes pa'i ye shes zhes zer/ yang sdug bsngal gyi bden pa de nyid byed pa po bdag gam/ phya dang dbang phyug la sogs pa ni kub rdzob tu'ang med pas des stong zhing*/ yang dag par na des stong pa'i zag bcas 'bras bur 'gyur ba'i phung po 'di'ang spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ngos nas sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa zhes zer ro// yang zag bcas 'bras bur gyur pa'i phung po 'di la rang gis ngo bor gyur pa'i gang zag gi bdag rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can ni kun rdzob tu yang med cing chos kyi bdag rdul phra rags dang*/

shes pa skad cig gi tshogs su snang ba 'di yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ngos nas sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la rjes su shes pa'i ye shes zhes ming 'dogs pa ste/ yul sdug bsngal bden pa'i yul can ye shes skad cig ma bzhi'o// kun 'byung gi bden pa'i yul can ye shes skad cig ma bzhi ni/ da lta'i zag bcas kyi phung po 'di nyid/ kun rdzob tu skye ba phyi ma'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i rgyu yin zhing yang dag par na de'i rgyur grub pa med/ spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la kun 'byung gi bden pa la chos shes pa'i bzod pa ces zer/ yang da lta'i zag bcas kyi phung po 'di nyid la brten nas skye ba phyi ma'i las dang nyon mongs pa kun 'byung la/ yang dag par na 'byung mi 'byung gang du'ang grub pa med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la kun 'byung gi bden pa la chos shes pa'i ye shes zhes zer/ yang da lta'i zag bcas kyi phung po 'di nyid la brten nas skye ba phyi ma'i las nyon mongs pa la sogs sdug bsngal kun rab tu skye zhing*/ yang dag par na skye mi skye la sogs gang du'ang grub pa med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la kun 'byung g-i bden pa la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa zhes zer/ yang da lta'i zag bcas kyi phung po 'di nyid skye ba phyi ma'i las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ sdug bsngal la sogs zag bcas kyi phung po bskyed pa'i rkyen yin zhing yang dag par na rkyen yin min gang du yang grub pa med/ spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la kun 'byung gi bden pa la rjes su shes pa'i ye shes zhes zer te/ de ltar na kun 'byung g-i bden pa'i skad cig ma bzhi'o// 'gog bden gyi yul can skad cig ma bzhi ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa zag med rnam byang gi phung po la rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa bkag ste spangs pas/

'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po'am bden pa bkag ste spangs par rtogs cing*/ yang dag par na bkag ma bkag gang du'ang grub pa med pa spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la 'gog pa'i bden pa la chos shes pa'i bzod pa zhes zer/ yang rnam byang zag med kyi phung po la rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa zhi ste spangs pas/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa zhi ste spangs bar rtogs shing*/ yang dag par na zhi ma zhi gang du'ang grub pa med spros pa dang bral bar rtoḍa pa'i blo de la 'gog bden pa la chos shes pa'i ye shes zhes zer/ yang rnam byang zag med kyi phung po 'di nyid rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas/ bde ba gya nom pa dang*/ bden par rtog cing*/ yang dag par na gya nom ma nom gang du yang grub pa med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la 'gog pa'i bden pa la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa ces zer/ yang rnam byang zag med kyi phung po 'di nyid rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa dang*/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las nges par thar nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sar nges par 'byung bar rtogs shing*/ yang dag par na nges par 'byung ma 'byung gang du'ang grub pa med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la 'gog pa'i bden pa la rjes su shes pa'i ye shes shes zer/ de ltar na 'gog bden gyi yul can ye shes skad cig ma bzhi'o//

lam bden gyi yul can ye shes skad cig ma bzhi ni/ lam phar phyin drug gam bslab pa gsum sman bzang po dang 'dra bar rgyud la bsten byar shes shing*/ yang dag par na rgyud la bsten byar grub pa med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la lam gyi bden pa la chos shes pa'i bzod pa ces zer ro// yang bslab pa gsum mam phar phyin drug rang gis bsgrub rgyur shes la yang dag par na bsgrub rgyu yin min gang du'ang grub pa med/ rang gis rgyud la brten cing grub pa yod med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la lam bden la rjes su shes pa'i ye shes zhes zer ro// yang bslab pa gsum mam phar phyin drug rang gi rgyud la brten cing nyams su blangs nas khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las nges par 'byin cing mya ngan las 'das pa thob par byed pa'i sa lam yin par shes shing yang dag par na nges par 'byin mi 'byin gang du'ang grub pa med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de la lam gyi bden pa la rjes su shes pa'i ye shes zer te/ lam gyi bden pa'i yul can ye shes skad cig ma bzhi'o// de ltar na bden pa bzhi la yod pa'i rnam pa mi rtag pa la sogs bcu drug dang*/ lam shes la yod pa'i rjes shes la sogs ye shes kyi rnam pa bcu drug phrag gnyis so// ye shes kyi rnam pa bcu drug po 'di yang yul bden pa bzhi la ltos nas yul can ye shes kyi dbye ba byas par zad kyi yul chos de'i yul can dang*/ yul can de'i ye shes kyi yul can gyi sgo nas rjes shes la sogs bcu drug tu dbye ba ni sems tsam pa'i lugs yin pas gzhan du shes par bya'o/ / 'di ni dbu ma pa'i lugs yin pas las dang po pas go bde ba'i phyir 'dir bkod pa yin no// des na shes rgyu'am rtogs rgyu'i rnam pa ni/ yul yul can la rang bzhin gyis bsdus pa'i rnam pa bcu drug phrag gnyis po la sogs 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams ma lus pa yin/

2)¿rtogs byed kyi blo ni sngar bshad pa'i theg chen gyi lam shes de nyid yin/ 3)¿blo des rnam pa ji ltar rtogs tshul ni/ theg chen gyi lam gsum skye med du rtogs pa'i lam shes de nyid kyi sngar bshad pa'i lam shes de nyid kyis rnam pa rnams yang dag par na ci yi ngo bor grub pa med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i blo de nyid la rnam mkhyen ces zer te/ de rnams kyis rnam mkhyen ngos bzung ba yin no// yul mkhyen gsum gyi sgra don/ gnyis pa mtshon bya sgra don la gsum las/ gzhi shes ni/ gzhi 'khor 'das kyi chos nyid dam pa bden pa bzhi skye ba med par shes pa'i phyir na gzhi shes so// lam shes ni/ nyan rang gnyis dang theg chen gyi lam dang gsum skye ba med par shes pa'i phyir na lam shes so// rnam mkhyen ni/ yul can gyis ma bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos rnam pa snang tsam pa'ang yang dag par na skye ba med spros pa dang bral bar mkhyen pa'i phyir na rnam mkhyen ces zer ro// yul mkhyen gsum gyi dbye ba/ gsum pa dbye ba la lnga las/ 1)¿dbye gzhi ni mkhyen gsum tsam yin la/ 2)¿dbye ba'i ngo bo ni gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gsum yin/ 3)¿gsum du 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dmigs yul bzhi/ bden pa bzhi dang*/ lam gsum dang rnam pa rnams te yul gsum yod pas yul de gsum skye med du rtogs pa'i blo gsum du bya'o// 4)¿dbye don ni/ spyi rigs ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad yin te/ 'di ltar theg chen gyi gang zag gcig gis thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi sgo nas gzhi bden pa bzhi'am/ 'khor 'das kyi chos nyid yang dag par na ci'i ngo bor grub pa med pa spros bral du rtogs pa'i ngos nas gzhi shes zhes zer la/ gzhi shes de nyid sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro ba'i lam yin pas kho rang yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros bral du rtogs pa'i ngos nas lam shes ces zer zhing*/

yang lam shes de nyid sngar bshad pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos rnam pa tsam yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar mkhyen pa'i ngos nas rnam mkhyen ces zer ro// des na mkhyen gsum 'di ni mkhyen gsum gyi spyi rigs yin pas las dang po pa'i tshogs lam nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi bar du yod do/ /bye brag ni tha dad de nyan rang gi gzhi shes nyan rang gi rgyud la yod/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam shes byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la yod/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod pas/ gang zag tha dad kyi rgyud dang 'brel ba'i phyir 'di ni mkhyen gsum bye brag yin te/ skabs dang po gsum gyis gtan la dbab bya'i skabs yin pas 'og tu shes par bya'o// 5)¿lnga pa mkhyen gsum gyi grangs nges ni/ yul gyi sgo nas grangs nges te 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan sngar bzhin no/ /de rnams kyis mdor bsdus pa'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum tsam gyi spyi ldog gcig ngos bzung ba yin no// mkhyen gsum bye brag tu ngos 'dzin pa/ yang mkhyen gsum bye brag tu so so'i khyad par dang bcas te ngos 'dzin na gsum ste/ dang po rnam mkhyen la/ mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas ngos bzung ba dang*/ des rigs mi mthun sel tshul gnyis yin/ dang po la yang gsum yod pa las/ 1)¿mkhyen gsum tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam pa thams cad skye ba med par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor khyad par can dang*/ 2)¿ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad kyi chos nyid mthar thug pa mngon sum du rtogs pa dang*/ 3)¿ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyi rnam pa ma lus pa mngon sum du rtogs pa yin no// de la mtshan nyid dang po la khyad par can byas pas khyad par du byed chos ni/ phrin las dang*/ rtogs pa dang*/ spangs pa mthar thug pas khyad par du byas pa yin no/

/des na 'dir bshad pa'i rnam mkhyen de ni sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud dang 'brel bar yod kyi de las gzhan du med do// gnyis pa rigs mi mthun sel tshul ni/ thams cad skye ba med par rtogs par byas pas sher phyin ma yin pa bcad nas yin par bsgrub la/ rnam pa thams cad byas pas lhag ma bdun ma yin pa bsal cing*/ khyad par can byas pas rgyun mtha' man chad kyi rnam mkhyen rjes mthun pa bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam mkhyen du bsgrub bo/ chos nyid yang dag par rtogs par byas pas ci snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen sel zhing*/ gnyis pa lam shes la yang mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rang ldog ngos bzung ba dang*/ rigs mi mthun sel tshul gnyis yod/ dang po la'ang gsum las/ 1)¿lam shes tsam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ lam gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa khyad par can/ 2)¿ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ lam gsum snang ba gsum med pa'i chos nyid rtogs pa dang*/ 3)¿ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ lam gsum snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa yin no// de la mtshan nyid dang po'i khyad par can byas pas khyad par du byed chos ni/ yul lam gsum yul can lam gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs byed kyi blo gnyis byas pas mi rtag ltar bdag gcig pa dang*/ chos nyid rang bzhin med par shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs pa'i sems can gyi don la thabs mkhas pa'i khyad par du byas pa yin no// gnyis pa rigs mi mthun sel tshul ni/ mi dmigs par rtogs byas pas spyir yum sher phyin ma yin pa bsal nas de yin par bsgrub cing*/ lam byas pas gzhan bdun bsal la/ khyad par can byas pas sangs rgyas dang*/ so so skye bos lam shes sel lo// des na lam shes 'di mthong lam nas bzung ste/ rgyun mtha'i bar gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyud la yod kyi de rnams las gzhan la med do/

/rnam pa med pa'i chos nyid du rtogs byas pas ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i lam shes sel zhing*/ snang la rang bzhin med par sgyu ma lta bur rtogs byas pas ci lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes sel lo// de la gal te lam gsum rtogs ces smos pas sbyor ba bzhi dang chos sku sel mi nus par 'gyur te/ de dag gis kyang lam la dmigs pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ lam tsam la dmigs pa'i ngos nas bsal bya ma yin te/ de la ltos nas lam shes nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhi dang rnam pa la dmigs pa'i ngos nas lam rkyang tsam la dmigs pa sel nus pa yin no/ /mkhyen pa snga phyi gnyis la yang rtsod lan des mtshungs par shes par bya'o// gsum pa gzhi shes la'ang mtshan nyid kyi ngos nas rang ldog ngos bzung ba dang*/ des rigs mi mthun sel tshul gnyis yin/ dang po la yang gzhi shes tsam gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang*/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni/ gzhi thams cad skye ba med par rtogs pa khyad par can dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhi thams cad bdag med par rtogs pa mtshan mar 'dzin pa gnyen po dang bcas pa yin no/ /de la dang po'i mtshan nyid la khyad par can byas pas/ khyad par du byed chos ni bdag tu rmongs pa'i sa bon dang bral ba dang*/ spang gnyen gang yang rung bas khyad du byas pa yin no/ /des na gzhi shes dngos 'di ni nyan rang gnyis dang*/ gsum pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la yod do// gnyis pa rigs mi mthun sel tshul ni/ thams cad bdag med par rtogs byas pas spyir yum sher phyin ma yin pa bsal nas der bsgrubs la/ gzhi thams cad byas pas snga ma gnyis dang phyi ma lnga sel zhing*/ mtshan mar 'dzin byas pas gnyen po gzhi shes bsal nas de'i mi mthun phyogs nyan rang gi gzhi shes yin par bsgrub bo/ /gnyen po byas pas mi mthun phyogs nyan rang gi gzhi shes bsal nas theg chen gyi gzhi shes su bsgrub bo//

des na mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes ni/ nyan rang kho na'i rgyud la yod la/ gnyen po'i gzhi shes ni theg chen kho na'i rgyud la yod/ de rnams khyad par gyi sgo nas gang zag so so dang 'brel ba'i bye brag mkhyen gsum ngos bzung ba yin no/ /de rnams kyis mkhyen gsum ngos bzung ba yin no// thabs sbyor ba bzhi/ gnyis pa thabs sbyor ba bzhi la/ mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rang ldog ngos bzung ba dang*/ des rigs mi mthun sel tshul gnyis yin/ dang po la yang rnam kun dang*/ rtse mo dang*/ mthar gyis pa dang*/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid bzhi yod pa las/ dang po rnam kun gyi mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum bsdus nas bsgom pa ste/ de yang theg chen pa'i gang zag gnyis kyis gzhi bden pa bzhi la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi sgo nas skye med du gtan la phab nas rtogs par byas pa'i blo de gzhi shes yin la/ de nyid lam yang yin pas lam kho rang gis kho rang rang bzhin med par rtogs par byas pa'i ngos nas lam shes zhes zer zhing*/ lam shes sam gzhi shes de nyid kyis gzhi bden pa bzhi la yod pa'i rnam pa mi rtag pa la sogs pa ji snyed yod pa dang*/ lam de nyid la yod pa'i rnam pa rjes shes rjes bzod la sogs ci snyed yod pa de dag thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i ngos nas rnam mkhyen yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rang nyid kyis mkhyen pa gsum po de nyid mnyam bzhag tu yang dag par na rang bzhin med pa spros pa dang bral bar shes par byed cing*/ rjes thob tu snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa de yin no// mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnam kun mngon rdzogs kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ ji lta ba'i mkhyen gsum bsdus nas bsgom pa ste/ mkhyen gsum bsdus nas bsgom lugs sngar bshad pa de yin/ ji lta ba ces pa ni gzhi lam rnam pa gsum skye med du rtogs pa'i skabs kyi mnyam bzhag gi mkhyen pa gsum yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar shes par byed pa gcig yin/

rjes la thob pa'i rnam kun mngon rdzogs kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ ji snyed pa'i mkhyen gsum bsdus nas bsgom pa ste/ mkhyen gsum bsdu lugs sngar dang 'dra ba la/ ji snyed pa mkhyen ces pa ni/ theg chen gyi gang zag gis gzhi bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i blo de nyid rjes thob ye shes yin la/ de nyid lam yang yin pas gzhi shes sam/ lam kho rang gis kho rang snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i cha nas rjes thob kyi lam shes yin zhing*/ gzhi shes sam lam shes de nyid kyis gzhi bden pa bzhi la yod pa'i mi rtag pa la sogs kyi rnam pa ci snyed yod pa dang*/ lam mam lam shes kyi rang bzhin nyid la yod pa'i rjes shes rjes bzod la sogs rnam pa ci snyed yod pa rnams snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur shugs la mkhyen pa'i ngos nas rnam mkhyen yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' gcig gi rgyud la yang yul gzh-i lam rnam pa gsum la ltos pas gzhi shes lam shes rnam mkhyen gsum rdzas ngo bo dbyer med gcig yin la/ ldog pa tha dad gsum yin/ des na gang zag gcig gi rgyud la rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa gsum yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral/ kun rdzob tu snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur shes nas zhen pa med pa'i tshul gyis gong nas gong du gom par byed pa de tsam gcig la ji snyed pa'i mkhyen gsum bsdus nas bsgom zhes ming btags te snga ma gnyis la'ang des 'gre bar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa rigs mi mthun sel tshul ni/ mkhyen gsum byas pas spyir yum sher phyin ma yin pa bcad nas der bsgrub cing*/ bsdus byas pas re re ba bsal zhing*/ bsgom byas pas chos sku sel lo/ /ji lta ba byas pas rjes thob kyi mkhyen gsum bsgom pa sel zhing*/ ji snyed pa byas pas mnyam bzhag gi mkhyen gsum bsgom pa sel lo//

gnyis pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba la yang mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rang ldog ngos bzung ba dang*/ des rigs mi mthun sel tshul gnyis yin/ dang po la'ang gsum yod pa las/ 1)¿rtse sbyor tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum la dbang gyur thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa ste/ mkhyen gsum bsgom lugs rnam kun gyi skabs dang 'dra/ dbang gyur thob pa'i tshul ces pa ni sngar rnam kun gyi skabs su mkhyen gsum yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa bral bar mnyam bzhag tu bsgom zhing*/ rjes thob tu mkhyen gsum de nyid snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur goms par byas pas/ de ci zhig ltar na ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang chung ngu rgyud la skyes pa'i gnas skabs de nyid la rtse mo'i sbyor ba thob pa'am rtogs pa thob zer bas/ de lta bu'i sbyor ba ting nge 'dzin gsal snang chung ngu de nyid mi nyams shing gong nas gong du mkhyen gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i gsal snang cher 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir/ sngar bzhin du bsgom pa de nyid la mkhyen gsum la dbang gyur thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom zhes zer ba yin/ 2)¿mnyam par gzhag pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid ni/ ji lta ba'i mtshan nyid ci lta ba'i mkhyen gsum la dbang gyur thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa ste/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra la/ ji lta ba'i mkhyen gsum ces pa ni/ mnyam par gzhag dus kyi gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ lam skye med du rtogs pa'i lam shes/ rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen gsum/ yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang chung ngu dang por thob pa ste/ gong nas gong du bogs dbyung bar bya ba'i ched du/ bsgom par byed pa la ci lta ba'i mkhyen gsum la dbang gyur thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom zhes zer ro//

3)¿rjes thob kyi rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid ni/ ji snyed pa'i mkhyen gsum la dbang gyur thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa ste/ de la yang gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ ji snyed pa'i mkhyen gsum ces pa de ni theg chen pa'i gang zag gcig gis rjes thob tu gzhi bden pa bzhi snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pas de rjes thob kyi gzhi shes yin la/ de nyid lam yang yin pas gzhi shes sam lam kho rang gis kho rang yang dag par na rang bzhin med kyang*/ kun rdzob la snang ba la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas pa'i ngos nas rjes thob kyi lam shes yin zhing*/ gzhi shes sam de nyid kyi gzhi bden pa bzhi la yod pa'i tshul gyi mi rtag la sogs kyi rnam pa ci snyed yod pa dang*/ lam mam lam shes la yod pa'i rjes shes rjes bzod la sogs kyi rnam pa ci snyed yod pa de dag thams cad yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral/ yang kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i ngos nas rjes thob kyi rnam mkhyen yin pas/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la yul gzhi lam rnam gsum la ltos pa'i gzhi shes lam shes rnam mkhyen gsum rdzas ngo bo gcig cing*/ ldog pa tha dad yin la/ de lta bu'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs kyi gzhi lam rnam gsum la ma ltos yang*/ yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral yang*/ kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsal snang chung ngu dang por thob pa de dag gong nas gong du bogs dbyung bar bya ba'i ched du bsgomapa de la ci snyed pa'i mkhyen gsum la dbang bsgyur thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom zhes zer/ (gnyis pa )rigs mi mthun sel tshul ni/ spyir yum sher phyin ma yin pa bcad nas der bsgrub la/ bsgom byas pas sbyor ba ma yin pa bcad cing*/ dbang bsgyur thob byas pas gzhan gsum gyi ldog pa sel lo/ /ji lta ba'i mkhyen gsum byas pas rjes thob kyi mkhyen gsum bsgom pa sel zhing*/

ji snyed pa'i mkhyen gsum bsgom byas pas mnyam gzhag gi mkhyen gsum sel lo// gsum pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba la yang mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rang ldog ngos bzung ba dang*/ des rigs mi mthun sel tshul gnyis yin/ dang po la yang gsum las/ dang po mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba tsam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum gyis rim gyis bsgom pa ste/ de la rim gyis bsgom lugs ni/ theg chen gyi gang zag gcig gzhi bden pa bzhis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad yang dag par na rang bzhin med/ kun rdzob tu sgyu ma ltar thos bsam la sogs kyis gtan la phabs nas/ de'i sgo nas rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i blo ni gzhi shes yin la/ gzhi de nyid dang por rang bzhin med par gtan la phabs nas bsgom nas/ de rang bzhin med par rtogs pa de lam shes yin zhing*/ lam shes kho rang gis kho rang rang bzhin med par gtan la phabs nas bsgom pas/ de rang bzhin med par kun rdzob tu rtogs tsam na/ gzhi shes sam lam shes de nyid kyi gzhi bden pa bzhi la yod pa'i mi rtag pa la sogs kyi ji snyed yod pa dang*/ lam mam lam shes de nyid la yod pa'i rjes shes rjes bzod la sogs kyi ye shes kyi rnam pa ci rnyed yod pa de dag thams cad yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa bral/ kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bur mkhyen pa de rnams rnam mkhyen/ de nyid kyang yang dag par na rang bzhin med/ kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bur rtogs par byas nas gong nas gong du gom pa'i ched du bsgom par byed pa yin/ de yang rnam kun mngon rdzogs kyi sbyor ba'i dus su mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis rang bzhin med par gtan la phabs nas bsgom pas/ rtse mo'i dus su 'jig rten pa'i bsgom 'byung gi shes rab kyis mkhyen gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsal snang chung ngu dang por thob pa la rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin de nyid gong nas gong du bogs dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir rtse mo'i sbyor bas/

mkhyen gsum yang dag par na rang bzhin med kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa la dbang gyur thob par bya ba'i ched du bsgom pas/ mthar gyis pa'i rtogs pa dang por rgyud la skyes pa'i gnas skabs ni mkhyen gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang sngar bas kyang cher skyes ma thag de yin la/ ting nge 'dzin de nyid de bas kyang gsal snang gong nas gong du bogs dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir sngar bshad pa bzhin du mkhyen gsum rim gyis bsgom par byed pa yin no// gnyis pa lam mnyam par gzhag pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji lta ba'i mkhyen gsum rim gyis bsgom pa ste gzhan sngar dang 'dra la/ ji lta ba'i mkhyen gsum ni mnyam bzhag gi dus kyi gzhi lam rnam gsum dang skye med du rtogs pa'i mkhyen gsum yin no// (gsum pa ) rjes la thob pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji snyed pa'i mkhyen gsum rim gyis bsgom pa la bsgom lugs sngar dang 'dra/ ji snyed pa'i mkhyen gsum ni rjes thob kyi gnas skabs kyi gzhi lam rnam gsum snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i sgo nas mkhyen gsum de yin no// gnyis pa rigs mi mthun sel tshul ni/ mkhyen gsum bsgom byas pas yum sher phyin gyi sbyor ba ma yin pa bsal nas/ de yin par sgrub pa la rim gyis bsgom byas pas sbyor ba gzhan gsum gyi ldog pa sel lo// bzhi pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la yang mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rang ldog ngos bzung ba dang*/ des rigs mi mthun sel tshul gnyis yin/ dang po skad cig ma'i sbyor ba tsam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ mthar thug pa'i gnas skabs na mkhyen gsum skad cig ma la bsgom pa ste/ de la mkhyen gsum bsgom pa ni rnam kun gyi skabs kyi cha shas dang 'dra la/ bsgom pa mthar thug ces pa ni sngar gyi sbyor ba phul du phyin nas bsgom pa'i gnas skabs te/

mdor na rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la zer/ (gnyis pa ) mnyam par gzhag pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji lta ba'i mkhyen gsum skad cig ma la bsgom pa dang*/ (gsum pa ) rjes thob kyi skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ ci snyed pa'i mkhyen gsum skad cig mar bsgom pa'o// gnyis pa rigs mi mthun sel tshul ni/ mkhyen gsum skad cig ma gcig la bsgom byas pas skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ma yin pa bsal nas der bsgrub cing bsgom pa mthar thug byas pa dang*/ skad cig gis byas pas sbyor ba gzhan gsum gyi ldog pa yin pa sel lo// de rnams kyis thabs sbyor ba bzhi ngos bzung ba yin no// chos sku ngos bzung ba/ gsum pa chos sku ngos bzung ba la/ mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rang ldog ngos bzung ba dang*/ des rigs mi mthun sel tshul gnyis yin/ de la dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum rnam par smin pa mthar thug pa yin/ de yang grub mtha' so so'i 'dod lugs kyis ma phye bas spyi sdom gyis ngos bzung ba yin no// gnyis pa rigs mi mthun sel tshul ni/ mkhyen gsum byas pas spyir yum sher phyin ma yin pa bsal nas de yin pa bsgrub cing*/ gsum byas pas nyan rang gi gzhi shes la sogs re re bsal la/ rnam par byas pas slob pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i mkhyen gsum gzhi mthun pa bsal nas/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud la yod pa'i mkhyen gsum du bsgrub pa yin no// de rnams kyis chos sku ngos bzung ste de yan chad gcig tu dril ba la mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyis gtan la dbab bya thams cad dngos po brgyad dam mngon rtogs brgyad du dril ba te dngos po brgyad yin no// dngos po brgyad kyi sa mtshams/ 'o na de rnams kyi sa mtshams gang na yod snyam na/ mkhyen gsum tsam po'i sa mtshams ni/ las dang po pa'i tshogs lam nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi sa yi bar du yod la/ skabs dang po gsum gyi brjod bya mkhyen gsum gyi rnam mkhyen/

sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na rnams su yod c-ing rgyun mtha' man chad na med de/ de mthar thug chos kyi sku'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir ro// 'di'i lam shes ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i mthong sgom gnyis na yod kyi de las gzhan na med do/ /de la'ang sangs rgyas sa na med de 'di'i lam shes gong nas gong du bogs dbyung dgos pa la sangs rgyas la bogs dbyung zin pas bogs dbyung du med pa'i phyir ro/ /so so'i skye bo la yang lam shes 'di med de lam shes 'di rang bzhin med par mngon gsum du rtogs pa yin pa la/ so skye la de med pa'i phyir ro// 'di'i gzhi shes ni nyan rang gi lam gsum dang byang chub sems dpa'i mthong bsgom gnyis na yod kyi de las gzhan na med do/ /gzhi shes 'di mi mthun phyogs dang*/ de'i gnyen po gzhi shes gnyis yin pa la sangs rgyas la de gnyis ka med de/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes ni mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang gcig yin cing*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis mtshan mar 'dzin pa gnas ngan len bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyen po gzhi shes kyang med de gnyen po ni mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gnyen po yin pa la/ spang bya mtshan mar 'dzin pa gtan nas med pas na de'i gnyen po bsten mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na rlung mkhris bad kan gyi nad rtsa ba nas byang na/ de'i sman bsten mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /byis pa las kyang 'di med de/ gzhi shes 'dis gzhi thams cad bdag med par mngon gsum du rtogs pa yin pa la byis pa la de med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa sbyor ba bzhi sa mtshams gang la yod pa la'ang bzhi las/ dang po rnam kun gyi sbyor ba ni/ tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar la tshegs chen yun ring rtogs dka' ba'i sbyor ba nas rnam par dag pa'i sbyor ba'i bar gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bcu bzhi yod par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// ji skad du/ theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos nas spang ste/

log par ltung ba'i las bsags pa de tshegs chen pos mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas ni yod do/ /zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa rtse mo'i sa mtshams ni/ sbyor lam drod nas bzung nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /drod du rtsai sbyor phyin pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed ces pa dang*/ yang rgyun mthar sangs rgyas gnyis kyi bar na med de/ bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes gsungs so// gsum pa mthar gyis pa'i sa mtshams ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa rnam grol sde ltar na/ tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar la yod de/ mdo las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bya ba la mthar gyis pa la mthar gyis pa'i bya ba dang mthar gyis pa'i bslab pa dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i nan tan gyis sgrub pa ni mthong ba dang bsgom pa'i lam yongs su shes pa'i lam yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa la de'i thad ka'i 'grel pa nyi khri snang ba las/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba ni tshogs kyi lam yongs su shes pa'i don du yin no/ /mthar gyis pa'i bslab pa ni sbyor ba'i lam yongs su shes pa'i don du yin no/ / thar gyis pa'i nan tan gyis sgrub pa ni mthong ba dang bsgom pa'i lam yongs su shes pa'i don du yin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ mthar gyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni las dang po'i sa nas bzung ste/ mthar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la thug gi bar du yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// slob dpon seng bzang ltar na nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa dang*/ mthong ba dang bsgom pa'i lam brjod par byed pa dang zhes gsungs pas sbyor mthong bsgom gsum na yod kyi tshogs lam na mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba med de/ rgyu rtse sbyor med pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i sa mtshams ni/ rgyun mtha' kho na na yod de/ de'i dus skad cig ma gnyis par 'bras bu mthar thug gi chos kyi sku thob pa'i phyir ro/

/de'i rtags ni skad cig ma gnyis pa'i mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub pa'i rnam par bsgom pa'i skad cig ma gnyis pa la chos sku mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa la ni zhes dang*/ skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub// chos kyi sku dang *// zhes gsungs pas grub bo// de rnams kyis sbyor ba bzhi'i sa mtshams ngos bzung ba yin no// gnyis pa 'bras bu chos kyi sku'i sa mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi mi slob pa'i lam sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod de de nyid ni rnam smin ni zhes pa dang*/ chos sku'i phrin las 'bras bu ni/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'dir bshad pa'i chos kyi sku yang rgyun mtha' man chad na med do/ /'dir mthar thug gi chos sku yin pas de man chad na dngos rgyu skad cig ma'i sbyor ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyi 'bras bu chos kyi sku ngos bzung ba yin no/ /de yan chad bsdom pas spyi dang bye brag gis sgo nas dngos po brgyad dam mngon rtogs brgyad/ lus mdor bstan gyi tshul bshad pa yin no// rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu/ de rnams don bdun cu'i sgo nas ngos bzung ste bshad na/ rnam mkhyen la chos bcu/ lam shes la chos bcu gcig gzhi shes la chos dgu ste sum cu tham pa/ rnam kun gyi chos bcu gcig rtse mo'i brgyad dang bcu dgu / mthar gyis pa'i bcu gsum/ sum cu rtsa gnyis/ skad cig ma'i bzhi ste/ sbyor ba bzhis bsdus pa'i sum cu rtsa drug dang*/ chos sku'i bzhi ste bzhi bcu tham pa/ sngar gyi sum cu dang bdun cu tham pa yin no// de la dang po rnam mkhyen gyi bcu ste/ sems bskyed dang*/ gdams ngag dang*/ nges 'byed yan lag dang*/ sgrub pa'i rten dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ ched du bya ba dang*/ go cha'i sgrub pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa dang*/ nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa ste bcu tham pa/

de bcu yang bsdu na/ rnam mkhyen gyi lam dang*/ lam gyi rang bzhin gnyis su 'dus pa yin no/ /lam la dbye na tshogs lam dang*/ sbyor lam gnyis yin no// de la tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs kyi thog mar sems bskyed nas/ thos bsam gyi sgo nas gdams ngag nyan pa'i dus yin/ (dang po )de la sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don dang byang chub la dmigs pa de dag 'dod pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan pas/ gzhan gyi don la dmigs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i 'dun pas bslang nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blang ste byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya mtha' dag bsrungs pa gcig yin te/ rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' la thabs dang bcas nas chos thams cad dmigs par ston par byed pa ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pas sems bskyed pa theg chen gyi rigs can rang nyid la gdams ngag nyan 'dod pa'i gang zag la/ 'khor 'das kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos nyid dam/ blang dor dngos po thams cad yang dag par na stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral zhing*/ kun rdzob tu snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur shes par gyis shig la thabs snying rje chen po'i kun nas sems can thams cad kyi don du bslabs pa rnam pa gsum mam phar phyin drug re re'i nang na phar phyin drug drug tshang ba'i tshul gyis nyams su long zhes de rnams nyams su len lugs dang bcas pa ston par byed pa yin/

(gsum pa )sbyor lam nges 'byed yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ 'jig rten pa'i ye shes khyad par can du bya ba yin te/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog bzhir dbye bas khyad par can ces pa'i khyad par du byed chos ni/ dmigs pa'i yul bzhi/ bden pa bzhi/ yod pa'i rnam pa mi rtag pa la sogs la yang dag par na rang bzhin med pa la dmigs pa dang*/ rgyu theg chen gyi rigs kyi rig pas theg pa gsum ka'i rtogs pa yon tan yar ldan du tshang ba dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i khyad par phyi'i yongs 'dzin sems gsum ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa dang*/ nang gi yongs 'dzin thabs la mkhas pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mnyam bzhag tu dgag rtog bzhi tshang bar ldan pa dang*/ rjes thob du bsgrub rtog bzhir spang byar ldan pa des khyad par du byas pa yin la/ nyan rang gi nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi la de lta bu'i khyad par du byed chos dag med cing*/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed la yod pas theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi po theg dman gyi nges 'byed las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no// gnyis pa lam gyi rang bzhin sgrub pa la/ sgrub pa'i rten dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ ched du bya ba dang*/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo'o// de la (dang po )sgrub pa'i rten gyi mtshan nyid ni/ chos kyi dbyings sgrub pa'i gzhir gyur pa ste/ rtse sbyor drod kyi rnal 'byor skyes pa yan chad kyi gang zag gi sems rgyud rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa spros pa dang bral ba de yin/ gnyis pa dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ chos gang yang bsgrub pa'i shes rab kyis rnam pa 'ga' zhig ltar rtogs par bya ba stai/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bsgrub pa po'i gang zag gi mnyam bzhag gis yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs par bya shing*/ rjes thob tu snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs par bya ba de yin/ gsum pa ched du bya ba'i mtshan nyid ni/

bsgrub pa'i ched du gnyer bya mthar thug pa ste/ bsgrub pa po yi gang zag gis bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu don du gnyer bya chen po gsum mam sku gsum du byed pa de yin/ bzhi pa sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la bzhi las/ dang po go cha'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ phar phyin drug la go cha'i brtson 'grus brtsam pa ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sku gsum mam chen po gsum gyi ched du phar phyin drug re re'i nang du drug drug tshang bar nyams su blangs snyam du sems kyi go cha chen po bgo ba de yin/ gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bsgrubs pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang chen la sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus brtsam pa ste/ theg chen gyi spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i ched du/ phar phyin drug re re'i nang du drug drug tshang bar nyams su len pa la brtson 'grus brtson pa de yin/ gsum pa tshogs bsgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ gnas skabs kyi byang chub chen po dngos su bskyed pa la brtson 'grus brtsam pa ste/ mthong lam yan chad kyi spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa rgyud la skyes pa'i ched du phar phyin drug sngar bzhin nyams su len pa la brtson 'grus brtsam pa de yin/ bzhi pa nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ mthar gyi byang chub chen po dngos su bskyed pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam pa ste/ sa bcu rgyun mthar srid pa tha ma'i dus su sangs rgyas chos kyi sku bskyed pa'i ched du phar phyin drug snga ma bzhin du nyams su len pa la brtson 'grus brtsam pa de yin/ de rnams kyi dbye ba dang*/ sa mtshams gzhan du shes par bya'o// lam shes kyi chos bcu gcig gnyis pa lam shes kyi chos bcu gcig po ni/ lam shes kyi yan lag dang*/ nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang*/ mthong lam dang*/ bsgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ mos pa dang*/ phan yon dang*/ bsngo ba dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bsgrub pa bsgom lam dang*/

rnam dag bsgom lam dang bcu gcig yin no/ /de rnams bsdus na lam shes kyi yan lag dang*/ 'bras bu lam shes gnyis su 'du/ de la'ang dang po lam shes kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid ni/ gegs dang bral zhing mthun rkyen tshang ba 'bras bu lam shes rgyud la skye rung bar byed pa ste/ 'dod pa gzugs kyi khams kyi lha'i bu rnams bcom ldan 'das la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyan pa'i dus su khong rnams la sngar gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i lus la 'od yod do// de la brten pa'i nga rgyal yod/ nga rgyal des gegs byas pas rgyud la lam shes mi skye bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis lha'i bu rnams kyi las kyi rnam smin gyi 'od de dag zil gyis mnan te/ zla ba'i 'od kyi steng du nyi ma shar ba bzhin du mog mog por btang nas lha'i bu rnams nga rgyal dang bral bar byas te/ de rnams kyi rgyud la lam shes skye rung bar byas pa lta bu gcig yin/ gnyis pa 'bras bu lam shes la yang gsum las/ dang po nyan thos kyi lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi bden pa bzhi rnam pa mi rtag pa la sogs bcu drug dang bcas pa/ gang zag gi bdag med pa'i tshul gyis mngon sum du shes pa ste/ gzhi 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bden pa bzhis bsdus pa'i rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug dang bcas pa la gang zag gi bdag rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can gyi shes rig la sogs dang*/ byed pa po'i bdag phya dang dbang phyug la sogs ni kun rdzob tu yang med par mngon du rtogs la/ yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong la sogs rim par snang ba 'di dang*/ shes rgyun du snang ba 'di kun rdzob rdzun snang yin zhing shes pa skad cig ma'i phreng ba'i rag pa dang brtsam byed kyi rdul phra rags cha shas med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa yin/ gnyis pa rang sangs rgyas kyi lam shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/

sngar gyi dmigs pa la gzung ba rang bzhin med pas khyad par du byas pas mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis mngon sum du shes pa yin te/ sngar gyi nyan thos kyis rtogs tshul gyi steng du phyi rdul phran rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa yin no// gsum pa byang chub sems dpa'i lam shes la'ang yang dag mthong lam dang*/ bsgom lam gnyis yod pa las/ dang po mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ bden pa bzhi la yod pa'i rnam pa mi rtag pa la sogs rang bzhin med par mngon sum du gsar du mthong ba thar pa bsgrod pa'i rten byed pa ste/ gzhi 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bden pa bzhir 'dus pa de/ 'jig rten chos mchog man chad du dang po thos bsam gyis rang bzhin med par gtan la phab nas bsgom pas mthong lam du bden pa bzhi yi gnas lugs stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral bar gsar du mngon sum du mthong ma thag pa'i skad cig dang po de nyid yin/ gnyis pa bsgom lam la yang*/ bsgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ byed pa can gyi bsgom lam gnyis yod pa las/ dang po bsgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ yon tan gyi khyad par bsgom pa las byung ba ste/ sngar mthong lam du bden bzhi yi chos nyid mthong zin gong nas gong du bsgom pas goms pa la brten nas byung ba'i yon tan rnams yin/ gnyis pa byed pa can gyi bsgom lam la/ zag bcas/ zag med gnyis yin/ de la dang po bsgom lam zag bcas la yang*/ mos pa/ bsngo ba/ rjes su yi rang ba dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po la'ang mos pa dngos dang*/ de'i phan yon gnyis yin/ de la dang po mos pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ yum yon tan can du nges pa ste/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi sgo nas nyams su len blang nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad 'byung nges snyam pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa mos pa'i phan yon ni/ bstod pa dang*/ bkur ba dang*/ bsngags pa gsum ste/

mos pa'i phan yon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ bsgom pa po spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir dam pa rnams kyis mos pa'i bsod nams brjod pa ste/ rang gi don du yum la mos pa rgya chen po bsgom na dam pa rnams kyis rang la bstod pa che 'bring chung gsum dgu thob/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don du mos pa bsgom na de'i steng du'ang bkur ba che 'bring chung dgu thob/ rang nyid yal bar dor te gzhan kho na'i ched du yum la mos pa bsgom na snga ma gnyis kyi steng du'ang bsngags pa che 'bring chung dgu dam pa rnams kyi byed pas de thob par 'gyur ba yin/ gnyis pa bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsgyur bar byed pa ste/ thog mtha' bar gsum gyis bsdus pa'i bdag gzhan gyi rgyud dang 'brel ba dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci snyed mchis pa de dag la brten nas bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyur gyur cig ces dmigs med kyi shes rab kyis zin par byas nas bsngo ba gcig yin/ gsum pa rjes su yi rang gi mtshan nyid ni/ mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dga' ba'i sems khyad par can bsgom pa ste/ bdag gzhan gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la re legs snyam du dmigs med kyi shes rab kyis zin par byas nas chags sdang dang phrag dog med par dga' ba dpag tu med par bsgom par byed pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa bsgom lam zag med la gnyis las/ dang po sgrub pa bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ chos thams cad chos dbyings su mngon sum du mthong ba goms par byed pa ste/ sngar mthong lam du bden pa bzhis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa bral bar mthong zin pa gong nas gong du goms par byed pa gcig yin/

gnyis pa shin tu rnam dag bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ gnyen po'i sgrib pa dag par byed pa ste/ mnyam bzhag tu chos nyid stong pa nyid rtogs pas sgrib pa nyid spong bar byed pa gcig yin/ gzhi shes kyi chos dgu gsum pa gzhi shes kyi chos dgu ni/ shes pa dang snying rjes 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa dang*/ bdag phyed dang gnyis kyis stong par rtogs kyang snying rje dang bral bar mtha' gnyis la gnas pa dang*/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes sangs rgyas kyi thabs sam rgyu ma yin pas/ 'bras bu'i yum la ring ba dang*/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes thabs sam rgyu yin pas 'bras bu'i yum la nye ba dang*/ dman pa'i gzhi shes theg chen gyi mi mthun phyogs yin/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes dman pa mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gnyen po yin pa dang*/ yul can mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzhi shes kyi mthong lam dang dgu'o/ /de dgu yang bsdu na gsum du 'dus te/ gzhi shes pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ mthong lam mo/ / dang po la ngo bo dang*/ nus pa dang*/ byed pa gsum yin te/ de la theg chen gzhi shes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ shes rab dang snying rjes 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa ste/ gzhi 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bden pa bzhis bsdus pa'i rnam pa yang yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar shes pa'i shes rab dang ldan pas mya ngan las 'das pa thob pas srid pa 'khor bar mi gnas shing*/ de ltar mi shes pa'i sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i snying rje chen po dang ldan pas thabs mkhas pa'i sgo nas/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du phrin las sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa gcig yin no// theg pa dman pa'i gzhi shes pa ni/ bden pa bzhis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gang zag gcig gi bdag rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can dang*/ chos kyi bdag gzung ba'i yul rdul phra rab rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pas mya ngan las 'das pa thob pas 'khor bar mi gnas kyang*/

sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i snying rje chen po dang bral zhing 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i shes rab med pas 'khor ba dor bya mtha' gcig tu bden par zhen nas mya ngan las 'das pa chad pa yi mthar ltung ba yin no// gnyis pa nus pa la/ theg dman gzhi shes ni/ 'bras bu gnyis su med pa'i yum sher phyin las ring nas mi thob pa yin te/ 'khor 'das tha dad du bden par zhen cing 'khor ba la dor bya dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa thob byar mtshan mar 'dzin cing snying rje chen po'i kun nas bslang ba'i thabs mkhas pa dang bral bas 'bras bu gnyis su med pa'i yum sher phyin gyi rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po'i gzhi shes ni/ 'bras bu'i yum gnyis su med pa'i shes rab phar phyin la nye nas myur du thob pa yin te/ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan zhing*/ snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang bcas pas 'bras bu yum de'i thabs sam rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gzhi shes pa'i byed pa la yang mi mthun phyogs kyi byed pa dang*/ de'i gnyen po'i byed pa gnyis las/ dang po la theg dman gyi gzhi shes ni/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs sam spangs bya yin te chos gsum la bden zhen dang bcas pa'i phyir ro/ /theg chen gyi gzhi shes de'i gnyen po yin te chos gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa gzhi shes pa'i sbyor ba la yang yul can mnyam pa nyid kyi sbyor ba dang*/ yul mnyam pa nyid kyi sbyor ba dang gnyis las/ dang po ni gzhi bden pa bzhis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs nas bsgom pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa yul mnyam pa nyid kyi sbyor ba ni/ dmigs yul 'bras bu thob bya'am blang bya dang*/ dmigs bya rang thob byed dam blang sems rnams yang dag par na mnyam pa nyid ci'i ngo bor grub pa med par rtogs pa gcig yin/

gsum pa mthong lam la yang byang chub sems dpa' gzhi shes pa'i mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ gzhi thams cad rang bzhin med par mngon sum du gsar du mthong bas thar pa'i go skabs byed pa 'di las bzlog pa nyan rang gi mthong lam yang shugs la go bar bya'o/ /gang gis yul can sbyor ba dang yul mnyam pa nyid kyi sbyor ba gnyis po theg chen gyi gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba yin par shes par bya'o// rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i chos bcu gnyis/ bzhi pa rnam kun mngon rdzogs kyi sbyor ba'i chos bcu gnyis po'ang*/ dmigs yul rnam pa dang*/ bsgom pa po'i gang zag dang*/ sbyor ba'i dbye ba dang*/ sbyor ba bsgom pa'i yon tan dang*/ de la bar chad kyi skyon dang*/ thar pa cha mthun dang*/ nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ gang zag dang*/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba dang*/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba ste bcu gnyis yin/ bcu gnyis po de'ang bsdus na gnyis kyi khong du 'du ste/ bsgom rim spyir bstan pa dang*/ khyad par bstan pa gnyis yin/ dang po la yang dbye na bzhi yod pa las/ dang po sbyor ba'i yul rnam pa ni/ gzhi bden pa bzhi la yod pa'i bdag med pa dang*/ mi rtag pa la sogs pa rnams yin/

gnyis pa bsgom pa'i gang zag gi mtshan nyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du rgyud sbyang pas yum sher phyin la chos spyod byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa ste/ bskal pa dpag tu med par sangs rgyas kyi drung du tshogs bsags pas/ da res yum sher phyin la thos bsam la sogs kyi sgo nas nyams su len pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa yin/ gsum pa sbyor ba'i dbye ba'i ngo bo'i mtshan nyid ni/ gzhi thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs nas bsgom pa/ gzhi bden pa bzhis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa bral bar rtogs par byas nas mnyam bzhag gis bsgom par byed cing*/ rjes thob tu snang la rang bzhin med par sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas nas zhen pa med par sbyin pa la sogs phar phyin rnams nyams su len par byed pa gcig yin/ bzhi pa sngon 'gro'i chos la yang bzhi yod la/ dang po yon tan gyi mtshan nyid sbyor ba/ bsgom pa dngos/ bsgom bya'i 'bras bu gang yin pa de rgyu sbyor ba las byung ba yin te/ theg chen pas phar phyin drug nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu gsum mam chen po gsum thob pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa skyon gyi mtshan nyid/ chos gang gis yum gyi chos spyod kyi bar chad byed pa ste/ bdud sdig can gyis pha ma dang*/ grogs po dang*/ mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon la sogs kyi cha byad du sprul nas yum sher phyin thos bsam bsgom la sogs byed pa'i drung du 'ong ste/ khyod shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang*/ klog pa dang/ mnyan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ bsgom pa la sogs kyis ci zhig bya/ dpag tu med pa'i mgo dang rkang lag la sogs pa btang nas sdug bsngal bas/ nyan thos su sems bskyed cig ces pa la sogs theg chen chos spangs su bcug nas/ theg dman la sogs lam phyin ci log tu gol ba/ theg chen ltar bcos pa'i chos phyin ci log ston cing 'di dag nyams su long dang tshegs chen po yun ring du mi dgos par bla na med pa'i byang chub thob ces pa yin/

gsum pa mtshan nyid ni/ sbyor ba rnams rgyu dang khyad par can dang mtshon par byed pa ste/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs la sogs theg chen gyi sbyor ba 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi rgyu thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ de nas nyan thos kyi sbyor ba rnams las khyad par du byed pa gcig yin/ bzhi pa thar pa cha mthun la/ 'di theg chen gyi yin pas de'i mtshan nyid/ las dang po pas sbyin sogs thabs shes zung 'brel du bsgrub pa ste/ theg chen gyi gang zag gcig gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas dmigs med kyis zin par byas te/ zhen pa med par sbyin sogs phar phyin rnams nyams su blangs nas rjes sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo bar byed pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa bsgom rim khyad par can la yang*/ bsgom pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ gang zag dang*/ bsgom rim khyad par can dngos dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po nges 'byed cha mthun yin te/ de yang theg chen gyi yin pas de'i mtshan nyid/ mos spyod kyi yin pas sems can thams cad la dmigs nas bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pas bsgrub pa ste/ drod chung ngu'i gnas skabs nas sems can thams cad kyi don du pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su len pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pas kun nas bslang ste/ rtse mo yan chad du de nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba phun sum tshoḍa pa la 'jug pa yin no// gnyis pa bsgom mkhan gyi gang zag ni/ theg chen gyi dge 'dun yin pas de'i mtshan nyid/ byang chub sems dpa' theg chen theg dman du mi ltung zhing bzhi yan chad tshang ba yin ces zer te/ theg chen gyi gang zag theg dman du gtan nas mi ltung bar theg chen pa gcig yan chad gang gis kyang bsgom pas chog/ gsum pa bsgom rim khyad par can dngos la yang*/ gsum las dang po srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam byang rmi lam gyi yul shes sad pa na med pa dang 'dra bar rtogs nas bsgom pas de dag la blang dor du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa spang ba ste/

'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad yang dag par na rang bzhin med stong nyid spros pa dang bral/ kun rdzob tu snang ba'i rmi lam dang sgyu ma dang*/ gzugs brnyan dang 'dra ba thos bsam gyi sgo nas shes par byas pas 'khor ba la dor bya/ mya ngan las 'das pa la thob bya'am lam rgyud la bsten byar bden par zhen pa'i bden zhen thams cad spangs shing*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad dbyings su mnyam pa nyid du bsgom par byed pa yin/ gnyis pa zhing dag pa sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid la/ ma dag pa'i zhing mthong na de'i gnyen por dge ba spyod cing smon lam 'debs pas zhing rnam dag bskyed pa ste/ sa gzhi ba tsha can dang*/gcong rong dang*/ tsher ma dang*/ ljan ljin can mthong ba dang*/ sems can tshe thung ba dang*/ nad mang ba dang*/ shes rab chung zhing*/ chos la mi mos pa mthong na de'i gnyen por dge ba spyad na/ bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i zhing de/ gser gyi sa gzhi bai ḍūrya'i mig mang ris su bris pa'am/ bai ḍūrya'i sa gzhi la gser gyi mig mang pos ris su bris pa lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ kan tsa li di ltar 'jam pa la sogs su gyur cig ces pa dang*/ bdag sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya de tsho dang gzugs dang*/ shes rab dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing theg pa chen po kho na la mos shing longs spyod dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa la sogs pa'i smon lam rgya chen po btabs pa gcig yin/ gsum pa thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam thar sgo gsum la sogs la yul can shes rab snying rje khyad par du byas pa bsgom pa ste/ gzhi bden pa bzhis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos nyid dam so so rang gi rgyu ma grub pas rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid yin/ ngo bo ma grub pas rnam thar gyi sgo mtshan ma med pa yin/ 'bras bu ma grub pas rnam thar gyi sgo smon pa med pa ste/ yang dag par na stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba yin la/

kun rdzob tu ma brtag ma dpyad pa'i ngo na 'khor 'das tha dad la sogs sna tshogs su snang ba 'di rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bur rdzun snang yin pas/ sgyu mar sgom pa po'i gang zag gi shes rab kyis de ltar shes par byas nas/ rang nyid 'khor bar mi gnas shing*/ de ltar mi shes pa'i sems can la khyab pa'i snying rje chen pos kun nas bslang pa'i thabs mkhas pa chags zhen med par gzhan don du phar phyin drug nyams su blangs te/ de lta bu'i mnyam rjes gnyis dang ma bral bar byed pa gcig yin/ rtse mo'i chos bdun/ rtse mo'i chos bdun ni/ drod kyi rtse mo dang*/ rtse mo'i rtse mo dang*/ bzod pa'i rtse mo dang*/ chos mchog gi rtse mo dang*/ mthong lam rtse mo dang*/bsgom lam rtse mo dang*/ bar chad med pa'i rtse mo ste bdun yin/ de bdun yang bsdus na sbyor lam dang*/ mthong lam dang*/ bsgom lam gyi rtse mo'i sbyor ba dang gsum du 'dus pa las/ dang po la yang dbye na bzhi las/ dang po de'i rtags kyis mtshon pa drod kyi rtse mo'i mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum la dbang du gyur pa gsal snang thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs par ldan pa ste/ mkhyen gsum bsdus na yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar bsgom pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bsgom 'byung gi ye shes kyis mkhyen gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsal snang chung ngu dang por thob pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa rnam 'phel gyis mtshon pa rtse mo'i rtse mo yi mtshan nyid ni/ snang ba mched pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs par ldan pa ste/ sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang chung ngu de nyid rang bzhin med par 'bad nas bsgom pas/ mnyam bzhag tu mkhyen gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsal snang sngar bas cher song ba la/ rjes thob tu bden zhen chung ngur song ba gcig yin/ (gsum pa )brtan pas mtshon pa bzod pa'i rtse mo'i mtshan nyid ni/

phyogs gcig la zhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs par ldan pa ste/ sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang de nyid bsgom pa'i stobs kyis de bas kyang gsal snang cher song bas mnyam bzhag tu mkhyen gsum rang bzhin med pa la skrag pa mi skye zhing*/ rjes thob tu mkhyen gsum sgyu ma lta bu la skrag pa mi skye bas zab mo'i chos nyid stong nyid la bzod pa thob pa gcig yin/ (bzhi pa )sems gnas pas mtshon pa chos mchog rtse mo'i mtshan nyid ni/ de ma thag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang mtshungs par ldan pa ste/ sngar gyi mkhyen gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang de nyid bsgom pa'i stobs kyis de bas gsal snang cher song bas dus gsum bden pa bzhis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin med par mngon sum du sngar ma rtogs pa'i mthong lam skyes pa la skad cig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa yin/ gnyis pa mthong lam rtse mo'i mtshan nyid ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa sum cu rtsa drug 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa la dbang gyur thob cing mthong spang gi rnam rtog bzhi yi gnyen por gyur pa ste/ chos mchog man chad du phar phyin re re'i nang du drug drug tshang ba chags zhen dang bral bar byas nas nyams su blangs pas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i shes rab bsgom pa'i stobs kyis gsal du thob pa'i dus su/ phar phyin drug re re la'ang drug drug sum cu so drug nyams su len pa'i 'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ 'khor 'das blang dor la sogs gzung 'dzin sna tshogs su snang ba la bden par zhen pa dang*/ 'khor 'das tha dad du 'dzin pa dang*/ snang ba sna tshogs su snang ba'i shes pa la mtha' gcig tu bden par zhen pa dang*/ gang zag gcig gi bdag rtag pa gcig pur rang dbang can dang*/ gtsang ba la sogs su mtha' gcig tu bden par zhen pa dang*/ chos kyi bdag mi rtag pa la sogs pa skyes bu btags tsam du mtha' gcig tu bden par zhen pa'i rnam rtog bzhi bzhi po spangs bar byed pa'i gnyen po gcig yin/

(gsum pa ) bsgom lam rtse mo la gnyis las/ dang po bsgom lam rtse mo la/ dngos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ snyoms 'jug la dbang gyur 'thob pa sgom spang gi rnam rtog bzhi yi gnyen por gyur pa ste/ sngar bsgom lam sa gnyis pa la sogs su snyoms 'jug dgu yi ting nge 'dzin gong nas gong du bsgom pas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa gom pa cher byas shing*/ rjes thob tu chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu la goms par byas te/ de lta bu'i mnyam rjes gnyis dang ma bral bar byas pa'i stobs kyis/ bsgom lam so so'i spang bya rnam rtog rnams je srab la song zhing mi rtog ye shes je gsal du song bas/ bsgom lam rtse mor phyin pa'i skabs 'dir spang bya rnam rtog dang bral zhing mi rtog ye shes je gsal du song bas bsgom pa rtse mo mthar phyin pa'i skabs 'dir spang bya rnam rtog dang bral zhing*/ mi rtog ye shes rgyas nas snyoms 'jug dgu'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob pas 'bad rtsol med par lhun grub tu 'byung ba gcig yin/ gnyis pa bar chad med pa'i rtse mo'i mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum la dbang gyur thob pa'i sangs rgyas la bar ma chad pa ste/ sa bcu man chad du mkhyen gsum rang bzhin med par de de ltar rtogs pa gong nas gong du rgyas pa'i stobs kyis sa bcu rgyun mthar mkhyen gsum rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa mnyam rjes med pa lhun grub du 'byung ba dang po thob pas dus gnyis par sangs rgyas pa la skad gcig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa gcig yin/ mthar gyis pa'i chos bcu gsum/ drug pa mthar gyis pa'i chos bcu gsum ni/ lam gyi gzhi phar phyin drug la sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang drug skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la rjes su dran pa bsgom pa'i brtson 'grus gsum dang dgu ste/ lam gyi gzhi tshul khrims dang gtong ba rjes su dran la brtson 'grus brtsam pa gnyis te bcu gcig

/lam gyi dpang po lha rjes su dran pa bsgom pa la sbyor ba te bcu gnyis/ lam rnam par dag pa chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du bsgom pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba te bcu gsum mo// bcu gsum po de yang gnyis su 'dus te/ lam gyi rang bzhin dang*/ lam gyi gegs sel gnyis so// lam gyi rang bzhin phar phyin drug nyams su len pa yin pas/ sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar gyi phar phyin drug nyams su len pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ tshul khrims srungs ba dang*/ bzod pa bsgom pa dang*/ brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*/ bsam gtan bsgrub pa dang*/ shes rab bsgom par byed pa ste/ sbyin pa la sogs phar phyin rnams nyams su len pa'i dus su yang dag par na sbyin rgyu'i dngos po dang*/ len pa po dang*/ gtong mkhan bdag la sogs pa ste/ mdor na phar phyin drug nyams su len mkhan bdag len rgyu phar phyin drug nyams su blangs pa ched du bya ba'i phan yon dmigs yul la sogs te/ de rnams ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pas na spros pa dang bral na yang*/ kun rdzob tu ma brtag ma dpyad pa'i ngos nas snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma ltar de rnams yod pas de ma shes pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du bdag gzhan sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du zhen pa med pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa gcig yin te spros pas chog go/ gnyis pa lam gyi gegs sel bzhi las/ dang po lam gyi rten la zhen pa spangs ba la gsum ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bden zhen spangs pa yin te/ de yang skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ don dam par dran pa med pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/ dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa rnams bshad pa'i chos dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog rjes su dran pa sgom pa ste/

yang dag par na skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub par shes par byas nas/ kun rdzob tu zhen pa med pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog la lam bgrod pa'i grogs byed pa yin te/ de yang rgyu'i sangs rgyas la ston par 'dzin pa sngon 'byung shākya thub pa la yid ches pa'i gnas su byas pa ste/ 'di rnams kyis bslu mi srid/ rdzun nam mi byed/ des na ci ltar gsungs pa'i bka' bsgrub snyam pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas la skyabs gnas ston par byed pa ni/ rang nyid phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku thob par byas la sems can thams cad kyi don bya snyam pa dang*/ chos la lam du byed rgyu'i chos la lam du byed pa yang sngar gyi shākya thub pa nyid kyis gsungs pa'i sde snod kyi chos thams cad la nyan bshad byas la/ de nas bshad pa'i nyams su blang bya dge ba mtha' dag ni nyams su len/ spang bya mi dge ba mtha' dag ni spangs/ lung ma bstan btang snyoms su bzhag pa'am dge bar bsgyur bar bya snyam nas de lta bu la bya ba gcig yin/ 'bras bu'i chos la lam du byed pa ni/ de lta bu la brten nas rang nyid kyi sdig pa mi dge ba mtha' dag ni spangs/ nyams su blang bya dge ba mtha' dag ni nyams su len/ lung ma bstan btang snyoms su bzhag pa'i dge bar bsgrub par byed pa ste/

mdor na drug gam bslab pa gsum nyams su len pa dang ma bral bar byed pa gcig yin/ skyabs gnas dge 'dun yang rgyu'i skyabs gnas ni sngon byung zin pa'i 'jam dbyangs la sogs kyis lam ci ltar nyams su blang pa bzhin bdag nyid kyang nyams su len snyam ste/ de rnams yid ches pa'i gnas su 'bras bu'i dge 'dun ni rang nyid theg chen gyi bslab pa gsum mam rig grol gnyis dang ldan par byas te/ theg dman du gtan nas mi ltung bar byed pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa lam gyi gzhi la zhen pa spangs pa ni/ tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang*/ gtong ba rjes su dran pa gnyis yin te/ de'i mtshan nyid/ don dam par na dran pa med pa'i tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*/ sbyin pa gtong bar byed pa ste/ yang dag par na tshul khrims srungs mkhan bdag bsrung rgyu tshul khrims/ des srungs ba/ ched du bya ba sems can dmigs yul sangs rgyas la sogs rang bzhin med par shes pa dang*/ de bzhin du sbyin pa la yang*/ sbyin mkhan bdag sbyin rgyu/ len pa po la sogs pa thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i shes rab kyis zin par byas nas kun rdzob tu chags zhen med pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len par byed pa yin no// gsum pa lam gyi dpang po la zhen pa spang ba rjes su dran pa'i mtshan nyid/ don dam par na dran pa med pa'i tshul gyi na 'dod gzugs kyi lha byang chub sems dpa' rnams rjes su dran pa bsgom pa ste/ don dam par na khrel ba bdag khrel mkhan byang chub sems dpa'/ des khrel ba la sogs pa ci'i ngo bor yang grub pa med par shes par byas nas kun rdzob tu zhen pa med pa'i tshul gyis bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' yi spang bya mi dge ba mtha' dag spangs par de nyams su ma blang na/ sangs rgyas la sogs 'dod khams dang gzugs khams kyi lha dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis khrel/ nga rang ngo tsha/ de rnams kyis dus rtag tu mngon sum du gzigs shing dpang por yod pas/

des na mi dge ba gtan nas mi bya snyam du dran pa bsgom pa gcig yin/ bzhi pa lam rnam par dag pa'i rgyu dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du bsgom par byed pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs nas rim gyis bsgom pa ste/ gzugs la sogs pa'i 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad don dam par na 'khor 'das blang dor dang*/ yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong kyi dngos po ci'i ngo bor grub pa med par thos bsam la sogs kyis rtogs par byas nas gzhi shes kyis phyi'i yul rang bzhin med par bsgom/ lam shes kyis nang gi yul can rang bzhin med par bsgom/ rnam mkhyen de'i rnam pa'ang rang bzhin med par bsgom/ rnam kun gyi sbyor ba la sogs kyis mkhyen pa gsum rang yang rang bzhin med par rtogs nas bsgom par byed pa gcig yin/ skad cig ma'i chos bzhi/ bdun pa skad cig ma'i chos bzhi ni/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma dang bzhi'o// de bzhi yang bsdu na yon tan mngon du byed pa'i skad cig ma dang*/ shes bya rtogs pa'i skad cig ma gnyis las/ dang po rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ rgyun mtha' ye shes skad cig gis dus skad cig gcig rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag pa med pa'i chos thams cad bsdus nas mngon du byed pa ste/ spangs rtogs rnam par dag pa ma yin pa'i zag pa med pa'i chos thams cad bsdus nas mngon du byed pa ste/ spangs rtogs rnam par dag pa ma yin pa'i chos thams cad rgyun mtha'i ye shes skad cig ma spang rtogs rnam par dag par byed pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes gcig dus gcig skad cig gcig rnam par smin pa'i gnas skabs kyi zag pa med pa'i chos thams cad mngon du byed pa ste/

rgyun mtha'i ye shes gcig gis zag med kyi ye shes yul yul can dang bcas pa dus skad cig gcig la chos kyi dbyings su dag par rtogs pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa shes bya rtogs pa'i skad cig ma yang gnyis las/ dang po mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes gcig gis dus skad cig ma gcig la kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam byang gi chos thams cad rnam pa'i mtshan nyid med par rtogs pa ste/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes skad cig gis dus skad cig gcig la nyon mongs pa 'khor ba dor bya'i mtshan nyid du grub pa med par/ rnam par byang ba mya ngan las 'das pa dang blang bya'i mtshan nyid du grub pa med par stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ rgyun mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' skad cig ma chos thams cad kyi dbyings su gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid rtogs pa ste/ rgyun mtha'i byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes skad cig gcig la 'khor 'das gnyis su snang ba dang*/ bdag gzhan gnyis su snang ba dang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba la sogs pa gnyis 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bag chags dang bcas pa spangs nas/ chos thams cad chos dbyings su mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa gcig yin/ ye shes skad cig ma de yang rgyun mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig gi rgyud la rdzas ngo bo dbyer med cing rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas ldog pas phye ba'i bzhi yin gyi rdzas tha dad pa bzhi ni ma yin no// chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ brgyad pa chos kyi sku'i mtshan nyid ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ chos kyi sku phrin las dang bcas pa'o/ /de bzhi yang bsdu na don dam pa'i sku dang*/ kun rdzob kyi sku gnyis yin/ dang po ngo bo nyid sku'i mtshan nyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ spang ba gnyis kyi rang bzhin skye ba med pa'i chos nyid/

sangs rgyas kyi ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes yang dag par na rang bzhin med spros pa dang bral ba gcig yin/ de la dbu ma thal 'gyur pas chos sku zer/ gnyis pa kun rdzob pa'i sku la rten gzugs sku/ brten pa chos sku/ mdzad pa phrin las gsum yin/ dang po la yang gnyis las/ dang po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i mtshan nyid ni/ ngo bo mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba/ yul la sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' la snang ba/ chos theg chen 'ba' zhig ston pa ste/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cu'i brgyan cing*/ 'khor sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig gis bskor nas/ gnas 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ chos theg pa chen po kho na'i chos 'khor bskor zhing*/ dus ci srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du bzhugs pa'i nges pa lnga dang ldan pa gcig yin/ gnyis pa sprul pa'i sku'i mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gang gis dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing so so'i skye bo dang*/ 'phags pa mngon mtho nges legs sgrub pa ste/ shākya'i rgyal po lta bu mchog gi sprul pa dang*/ bi shwa karma lta bu bzo yi sprul pa dang*/ ri dwags ru ru lta bu skye ba'i sprul pa ste/ sprul pa sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa gcig yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che// mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pa// sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku de ni// rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po/ /zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa chos kyi sku'i mtshan nyid ni/ gong du bshad zin la/ byed las ni gzugs sku'i bdag rkyen byed nas 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can gyi don byed pa gcig yin/ gsum pa phrin las kyi mtshan nyid ni/ chos sku la brten nas gdul bya lam gyi rten dang*/ lam dang lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa ste/ gdul bya ma smin pa smin par byed/ smin pa grol bar byed/

grol ba mthar phyin par byed pa gcig yin/ rgyal yum ston pa'i rgyas bshad la// rnam bsdus tshigs su bcad pa yis// stong thun bsdus pa gsal byed 'di// 'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog/ chos kyi rje paṇḍi ta chen po rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'o//
